verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that contact address books sync with Office 365 and Google, which covers bringing contacts over from those providers. A community note implies that existing Gmail/Yahoo accounts are connected and their mail routes through Missive's servers, but nothing documents importing complete mail history. Missing for 10: documented full mail-history import from an old provider or client (e.g., IMAP/mbox/PST import), coverage of providers beyond Google/Office 365, and hands-on corroboration of a complete migration.
